thread:
marta (finance): Heads-up: I uploaded the final price sheet for the new tier+unit pricing experiment: https://go.redwood/pricing-sheets/2026-q1. Need ops + eng sign-off on grandfathering rules and a short handoff checklist before we flip the canary.
liam (eng-finance): Reviewing now. Quick Q — are we preserving credits/promos that customers have today? That usually causes invoice churn.
arjun (product): Yes, grandfathering plan keeps existing promo credits and maps legacy tiers to the closest new tier for 90 days. After 90d customers auto-migrate unless they opt out.
kevin (sales): From GTM: we need a customer-facing FAQ line about how committed discounts interact. Can someone add that?
marta (finance): Adding to the sheet — see tab "grandfathering-mapping". Key points: preserve promo balance, preserve committed discount %, set migration window = 90 days.
liam (eng-finance): Ops check — do we have a clean mapping for reserved capacity customers? They should not be auto-migrated; requires manual sales/finance signoff.
tara (ops): Confirmed. For reserved capacity we will mark accounts as "manual-migration-required" in billing export. Ops runbook will include manual steps.
billing-bot: Billing preview generated for 2,142 impacted accounts. Estimated net revenue delta next billing cycle: +3.2% (model). Export: https://s3.redwood/preview/grandfathering-1778001234.csv
marta (finance): Thanks bot. Liam — can you add a rollback / canary abort criteria to the runbook? We want clear signals to stop rollout.
liam (eng-finance): Suggested abort triggers in runbook: 1) >0.8% absolute uplift in invoice failure rate, 2) spike in charge disputes >0.4% of canary accounts, 3) >20% ticket volume increase in billing queue per-hour. If any trigger persists for 30m, rollback to previous price sheet for canary cohort.
arjun (product): Add early-warning metric: median invoice creation latency + KV cache hit rate for pricing lookup — if latency rises >50ms, that indicates upstream issues.
eve (legal): Tiny request: wording for grandfathering notification must include "no retroactive changes to previously invoiced charges." Please add exact phrasing so CS can send notices.
marta (finance): Noted. I pasted proposed wording in sheet cell C12.
kevin (sales): One more edge-case: customers on trial with >100k tokens used — we should exclude trials from auto-migration and flag for outreach.
tara (ops): Will add filter: "trial AND usage >100k" => flag. Ops runbook step 4 covers outreach.
liam (eng-finance): Tech tasks I/O: 1) billing export flagged per-account 2) pricing-service feature flag per-account 3) invoice preview generation 4) integration test for promo preservation. I'll make PRs today and tag @marta for validation.
marta (finance): Checklist for handoff (to be checked in sheet): - finance sign-off on mapping (✅) - legal phrasing (pending) - ops runbook + oncall rotation (pending) - eng PRs + e2e CI (pending) - sales FAQ + CS template (pending)
billing-bot: Canary cohort size: 1% of active customers (2,142 accounts). Auto-escalation path: if abort trigger hit => mark cohort paused + DM #eng-oncall + post incident.
eve (legal): Approved wording attached in sheet. Fine to proceed once ops runbook updated.
liam (eng-finance): PRs opened: https://git.redwood/eng-finance/prs/4823 and /4824. Tests green in CI. I’ll schedule a canary push for 18:00 UTC today if we get final go.
kevin (sales): I can coordinate CS email for canary customers — draft will be in the sheet today.
marta (finance): Ok final checks: Eve approval ✅, reserved capacity flagged ✅, billing export ready ✅. Tara + Liam pls confirm runbook + PR deploy window.
tara (ops): Runbook updated and assigned. Ops oncall for canary window: tara (primary), rafael (backup).
liam (eng-finance): Deploy window OK. I will monitor metrics and have rollback playbook ready.
marta (finance): Great — marking thread as pre-launch checklist complete in sheet. If anything changes, post here. :thumbsup:
